name: NVIDIA/Q2RTX
description: NVIDIA's fully path-traced implementation of Quake II with RTX global illumination, demonstrating real-world ray tracing in a complete game. Historically significant as an early showcase of consumer RTX hardware.
score_rationale: 1.3k-star landmark project showing real-time path tracing in a full game, significant historical reference for RTX adoption.
summary: Full path-traced Quake II implementation demonstrating real-time RTX ray tracing
